detail: Full summary: ROOT CAUSE of the field outage, found by Dave: an npmrc policy requiring packages be at least 7 days old. npx exists and `npx --version` succeeds, so resolve_runner commits to the npx rung, then `npx -y twining-mcp` is refused by the registry. Because the rung used exec, the shell was replaced and rung 4 — the dependency-free bundled server needing no registry at all — was never reached.
